body:
Shared-furniture provenance needs real PowerPoint editing evidence: XML-only mutations cannot establish whether current text, image content and tags survive native save/reopen. Add bounded picture-edit and furniture workers, explicit validated action plans, current-registry furniture fixtures, and non-Office Windows safety checks.

The workers retain input/script/plan snapshots, per-call stages, native observations, slide PNGs, saved PPTX files and parent cleanup results. They stop after a failed Office call, never quit or kill Office, and close only their exact owned saved paths. PowerShell 5.1 action-plan tests cover empty/single/multiple lists and 13 invalid plans; collection and failure-latch checks run in Windows CI.

Validation on recovered PowerPoint 16.0.20326.20158, Windows 26200.9457, PowerShell 5.1.26100.9444, Node 24.21.0:

- Three native picture edit lifecycles passed: crop/geometry plus cleared alt, delete/add replacement, and deletion. The current importer explicitly reports unsupported-image-crop; crop/reflow fidelity remains unaccepted.
- Nine furniture baseline/action cases passed native save/reopen and independent semantic reimport: inheritance, explicit empty/false, changed/cleared text and alt, image deletion, slide reorder, duplicated tagged shape, missing/changed tags, and metadata disagreement.
- A separate actual UI Change Picture edit retained the current image bytes, cleared alt, shape identity and tag payload through a tenth native furniture lifecycle. PowerPoint changed its picture geometry; no geometry-preservation claim is made for that edit.
- Native observation audits, archive CRC/XML checks, and six synthetic negative auditor controls passed. Both pure PowerShell harness checks and Node syntax checks passed locally.

No exporter/importer runtime behavior, package version, production notes ordering, native p:hf or acceptance tolerance changes. Finite current-content acceptance is separate from formatting, arbitrary-edit, font identity and browser fidelity.

---

> [!NOTE]
> **Low Risk**
> Changes are test harnesses, docs, and Windows CI checks only; no production exporter/importer runtime changes in this diff.
> 
> **Overview**
> Adds **bounded Windows PowerPoint test harnesses** for native picture edits and furniture lifecycles, plus registry fixture generation and CI gates that run **without Office**.
> 
> **Picture edit:** `native-picture-edit.ps1` drives alter (crop/geometry/alt), replace (delete + `AddPicture`), or delete on a one-slide, one-picture deck; it snapshots inputs, stages every COM step, exports rasters, save/reopen, and fail-closed cleanup. `compare-native-picture-edit.mjs` checks a run against a pinned registry generation and reimport behavior (including documenting `unsupported-image-crop` for alter). Docs in `docs/native-picture-edit.md`.
> 
> **Furniture:** `native-furniture-control.ps1` runs save → optional JSON **action plan** (up to 20 ops: text, alt, shapes, tags, slide move) → save/reopen with per-slide observations and PNGs. `native-furniture-fixtures.mjs` emits baseline and controlled OOXML-variant decks from the registry consumer for later native runs. Docs in `docs/native-furniture-control.md`.
> 
> **Safety in CI:** Windows job now runs `native-picture-edit-harness-check.ps1` and `native-furniture-harness-check.ps1` (AST-only validators for parsers, action plans, collection identity, failure latch) alongside existing native harness checks.
> 
> <sup>Reviewed by [Cursor Bugbot](https://cursor.com/bugbot) for commit 08850fc372e32cb41ea63e50d418cd3a17b497a8. Configure [here](https://www.cursor.com/dashboard/bugbot).</sup>
